claim_traces.claim_title: Great Wall of China visible from space
claim_traces.claim_text: "The Great Wall of China is the only man-made structure visible from space with the naked eye."
reasoning_steps: The claim that the Great Wall of China is the only man-made structure visible from space with the naked eye is a well-documented misconception
NASA scientists and astronauts—including Yang Liwei, China's first astronaut in space—have confirmed that the Great Wall is virtually impossible to see from low Earth orbit with the unaided eye
Because it is relatively narrow (typically only 6 to 9 meters wide) and constructed from local stone and soil, it blends closely into the surrounding landscape
Conversely, many other man-made features, such as city lights at night, major highways, large dams, and airports, can be seen from orbit under favorable conditions.
